en: Black-and-white photographic postcard showing a large crowd gathered in front of a small wooden church with a bell tower and cross. The church façade is decorated with garlands and the number "300" above the entrance, suggesting a 300-year jubilee. Numerous flags line the road leading to the church. The foreground shows many people in early‑20th‑century clothing. Handwritten text is visible at the bottom of the image.
